[Figure 1]

In the right triangle shown, what is the value of $y$?
explanation: Choice D is correct. In the right triangle shown, both legs have a length of $29$. Since the two legs have the same length, this is an isosceles right triangle (a 45-45-90 triangle). In an isosceles right triangle, if each leg has length $a$, the hypotenuse has length $a\sqrt{2}$. Here $a = 29$, so the hypotenuse is $29\sqrt{2}$. Therefore, the value of $y$ is $29\sqrt{2}$.
